result.stdout:
dicomkit 1.0.0 - DICOM command-line tool built on DicomKit

Usage: dicomkit <command> [arguments] [options]

Commands:
  echo       C-ECHO an SCP (DICOM ping) and print the round-trip time
  store      C-STORE files and folders to an SCP over one association
  find       C-FIND: query an SCP for patients, studies, series or images
  move       C-MOVE a study or series to a destination AE
  worklist   Modality Worklist C-FIND: list scheduled procedure steps
  anonymize  De-identify DICOM files into a folder (PS3.15-style profile)
  dump       Print the elements of a DICOM file and any parse issues

Options:
  -h, --help     Show help (also: <command> --help, help <command>)
  --version      Show the tool version

License: the tool is free, but the DicomKit toolkit it runs on needs a license key. A free Developer
key (development and testing) takes a minute: https://dicomkit.plogic.dev/DeveloperKey
Pass it with --license-key KEY on any command, or set the DICOMKIT_LICENSE_KEY environment variable.

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 failure, 2 usage error, 3 parse errors (dump), 10 no license key, 130 cancelled.

dicomkit echo - C-ECHO an SCP (DICOM ping) and print the round-trip time

Usage: dicomkit echo <host> <port> [--called AE] [--calling AE]

Opens an association, sends one C-ECHO and releases. Exit code 0 when the SCP answers Success.

Options:
  --called AE        Called AE title, the SCP's (default ANY_SCP)
  --calling AE       Calling AE title, ours (default DICOMKIT_SCU)
  --timeout SECONDS  Connect and response timeout in seconds (default: connect 15, response 60).
  --license-key KEY  License key (PLGIC-... or a signed PLGIC1... license); default: DICOMKIT_LICENSE_KEY. Free Developer key: https://dicomkit.plogic.dev/DeveloperKey
  -h, --help         Show this help

dicomkit store - C-STORE files and folders to an SCP over one association

Usage: dicomkit store <host> <port> <file-or-folder>... [--recursive] [--called AE] [--calling AE]

Reads the metadata of every file first (pixel data is not loaded) to propose the right SOP classes and transfer
syntaxes, then streams each file. Non-DICOM files are skipped. Prints the DIMSE status per file and a summary.
Exit code 0 when every DICOM file was stored with status Success (or a warning).

Options:
  -r, --recursive    Include files in sub-folders of folder arguments
  --called AE        Called AE title, the SCP's (default ANY_SCP)
  --calling AE       Calling AE title, ours (default DICOMKIT_SCU)
  --timeout SECONDS  Connect and response timeout in seconds (default: connect 15, response 60).
  --license-key KEY  License key (PLGIC-... or a signed PLGIC1... license); default: DICOMKIT_LICENSE_KEY. Free Developer key: https://dicomkit.plogic.dev/DeveloperKey
  -h, --help         Show this help

dicomkit find - C-FIND: query an SCP for patients, studies, series or images

Usage: dicomkit find <host> <port> [--level patient|study|series|image] [--patient-name NAME] [--patient-id ID] [--study-date DATE]
         [--accession NUMBER] [--modality CODE] [--study-uid UID] [--series-uid UID] [--json] [--called AE] [--calling AE]

Uses the Study Root information model, and Patient Root for --level patient. Keys left out are returned
(universal matching). Series and image queries are hierarchical: they need the UIDs of the levels above.
Exit code 0 when the query completed, even with no matches.

Options:
  --level LEVEL        Query level: patient, study (default), series or image
  --patient-name NAME  Patient's Name, wildcards allowed (DOE^J*)
  --patient-id ID      Patient ID
  --study-date DATE    Study Date, YYYYMMDD or a range YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD
  --accession NUMBER   Accession Number
  --modality CODE      Modality (study level: Modalities in Study)
  --study-uid UID      Study Instance UID (required for series and image)
  --series-uid UID     Series Instance UID (required for image)
  --json               Print the matches as JSON instead of a table
  --called AE          Called AE title, the SCP's (default ANY_SCP)
  --calling AE         Calling AE title, ours (default DICOMKIT_SCU)
  --timeout SECONDS    Connect and response timeout in seconds (default: connect 15, response 60).
  --license-key KEY    License key (PLGIC-... or a signed PLGIC1... license); default: DICOMKIT_LICENSE_KEY. Free Developer key: https://dicomkit.plogic.dev/DeveloperKey
  -h, --help           Show this help

dicomkit move - C-MOVE a study or series to a destination AE

Usage: dicomkit move <host> <port> --dest AE --study-uid UID [--series-uid UID] [--called AE] [--calling AE]

Asks the SCP (Study Root) to send the study, or one series of it, to --dest. The destination AE must be
configured on the SCP. Progress (remaining / completed / failed / warning) is printed as the SCP reports it.
Exit code 0 when the final status is Success.

Options:
  --dest AE          Move destination AE title; the SCP must know its address (required)
  --study-uid UID    Study Instance UID to move (required)
  --series-uid UID   Move only this series of the study
  --called AE        Called AE title, the SCP's (default ANY_SCP)
  --calling AE       Calling AE title, ours (default DICOMKIT_SCU)
  --timeout SECONDS  Connect and response timeout in seconds (default: connect 15, response 60).
  --license-key KEY  License key (PLGIC-... or a signed PLGIC1... license); default: DICOMKIT_LICENSE_KEY. Free Developer key: https://dicomkit.plogic.dev/DeveloperKey
  -h, --help         Show this help

result.stdout:
dicomkit anonymize - De-identify DICOM files into a folder (PS3.15-style profile)

Usage: dicomkit anonymize <input-file-or-folder> <output-folder> [--salt-file PATH] [--recursive]

Writes each de-identified file to <output-folder>, named by its new SOP Instance UID. Private tags are removed.
Pseudonyms and new UIDs derive from a salt: reuse the same salt file to keep them consistent across runs
(a study anonymized in two batches stays one study). The salt is a secret: keep it out of the output folder.
Non-DICOM files are skipped. Exit code 0 when no file failed.

Options:
  --salt-file PATH   Salt file: read if it exists, otherwise created (default ./anonymize.salt)
  -r, --recursive    Include files in sub-folders of a folder input
  --license-key KEY  License key (PLGIC-... or a signed PLGIC1... license); default: DICOMKIT_LICENSE_KEY. Free Developer key: https://dicomkit.plogic.dev/DeveloperKey
  -h, --help         Show this help

dicomkit dump - Print the elements of a DICOM file and any parse issues

Usage: dicomkit dump <file>

Prints the file meta group and the data set (tag, VR, keyword, value), walks into sequences and lists parse
issues. Pixel data and other large values are not loaded. Exit code 3 when the file has parse errors.

Options:
  --license-key KEY  License key (PLGIC-... or a signed PLGIC1... license); default: DICOMKIT_LICENSE_KEY. Free Developer key: https://dicomkit.plogic.dev/DeveloperKey
  -h, --help         Show this help
